ctx.x: I heard him on the record. Oh boy. I used to practically live with him. You know Sam Morgan, the first one I seen used a clap stick. You know the slap stick? Mm-hmm. When you put that horn down, boy, you got a slap stick. That's right. Slap. Slap stick. He had a band, had kept what you call. Time. Boy's class. I never saw no band keep that good time as Sam Morgan. Well, what about yourself when you developed your style on clarinet? Did you have anybody that inspired you? Nobody but the band. But I mean you didn't…

Anywhere. Well we had a clarinet player, yeah he was good himself. And Paul Maurice, he used to play in the Supreme Band. We used to go to the automobile and he'd take everybody out of his attention towards him when he started playing that clarinet. He was good. He'd take parts out of his clarinet.
